2026.title: Mallakhamb Competition 2026
2026.description:
The ‘Mumbai Cha Raja Cup 2026’ Invitational Divisional Mallakhamb Competition, organized by Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli (Mumbai Cha Raja), was successfully held on 26 April 2026 at Ganesh Maidan, Ganesh Galli.

The event aimed to promote Maharashtra’s traditional adventure sport, Mallakhamb, at a global level. It was conducted under the guidance of Ruturaj Sports Academy and approved by the Maharashtra Amateur Mallakhamb Association and Mumbai City District Mallakhamb Association. The competition was inaugurated by Padma Shri Uday Deshpande Sir.

Highlights of the competition:
👉🏼 4 divisions (Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburban, Thane, Palghar)
👉🏼 17 reputed teams
👉🏼 140 talented athletes
👉🏼 12 national and international judges

Ruturaj Sports Academy delivered an outstanding performance and secured the overall team championship in both boys and girls categories, becoming the proud winners of the Mumbai Cha Raja Cup 2026.

Heartfelt congratulations and thanks to all participants, teams, coaches, judges, and sports enthusiasts.

2026.title: Public Service is Divine Service
2026.description: On Saturday, 28th February 2026, on behalf of the above festival committee, the sarees offered to Lalbaug Mata were distributed as prasad to the devoted women of the Chaitraban area in Shahapur.

2026.title: Free Eye Check-up Camp organized by Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli
2026.description: On Sunday, 22nd February 2026, the Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli (Mumbai Cha Raja), successfully organized the 'Free Eye Check-up, Spectacle Distribution and Cataract Surgery Camp'.

2025.title: Ranichi Bagh Educational Tour
2025.description: On 20th December 2025, the Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli, successfully organized the 'Ranichi Bagh' educational tour with great enthusiasm. The children not only saw animals but also befriended nature. Chief guide Dr. Abhishek Satam (@dr.abhisheksatam22) explained about animals and nature in very simple language, making this tour truly 'educational'. From Humboldt penguins to various native and foreign birds, every sight was met with remarkable excitement from the children. The joy on their faces is the true success of the committee. Heartfelt thanks to everyone for the overwhelming response to this initiative!

2025.title: Mega Blood Donation Camp - 2025
2025.description: On Sunday, 14th December 2025, the Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli (Mumbai Cha Raja), successfully organized the Mega Blood Donation Camp - 2025. The committee extends heartfelt thanks to the local citizens, advertisers, well-wishers, and volunteers who supported this initiative!

2025.title: Graduate and Postgraduate Student Felicitation Ceremony
2025.description: On behalf of the above festival committee, on Saturday, 13th December 2025, the 'Graduate and Postgraduate Student Felicitation Ceremony' was successfully held. Special thanks to the chief guest, counselor Dr. Purva Borkar Shingre, and heartfelt appreciation to the meritorious students and their parents!

2025.title: Free Naturopathy (Acupressure) Camp
2025.description: On behalf of the above festival committee, on Saturday, 13th December 2025, the Free Naturopathy (Acupressure) Camp was successfully conducted. Special thanks to the guiding naturopathy expert Dr. Sunil Dalvi for his valuable presence.

2025.title: Positive Parenting - Counseling
2025.description: On behalf of the above festival committee, on Saturday, 13th December 2025, the 'Positive Parenting - Counseling' program was successfully conducted. Special thanks to counselor Dr. Purva Borkar Shingre for her valuable guidance during the event!

2025.title: Mumbaicha Raja Tree Plantation Initiatives
2025.description: Keeping the spirit of social service alive just like the enthusiasm of Ganeshotsav, the office bearers and volunteers of Mumbai Cha Raja (Ganesh Galli) successfully carried out a tree plantation drive on Sunday, August 10, at Palsdari Road in Karjat.

2025.title: Free Eye Checkup & Cataract Surgery Camp
2025.description: On Sunday, February 2, 2025, Mumbai Cha Raja organized a free eye checkup camp. Cataract patients will undergo surgery at Sir J.J. Hospital using imported lenses and laser technology under expert medical guidance.

2025.title: Yoga & Baton Training Camp
2025.description: On public demand, a yoga and baton training camp was held specially for the adult group.

2024.title: Free Eye Checkup & Cataract Surgery Camp
2024.description: On Sunday, February 25, 2024, Mumbai Cha Raja successfully hosted a free eye screening camp. Cataract patients will be treated at Sir J.J. Hospital using laser procedure at no cost.

2023.title: Health Checkup Camp – 2023
2023.description: On Tuesday, June 6, 2023, to mark the 350th Shiv Rajyabhishek anniversary, Mumbai Cha Raja Mandal organized a health screening camp for police personnel at Kalachowki Police Station.

2022.title: Mega Blood Donation Camp – 2022
2022.description: On December 4, 2022, Mumbai Cha Raja held a mega blood donation camp. A total of 1,920 donors came forward, making the event a great success. As per tradition, donors were encouraged with essential gifts. Local representatives, social organizations, and other festival committees also attended. Blood banks from KEM, Sir JJ, JJ Metro, Nair, Jaslok, Raheja, Wadia, and Sion Hospitals participated and offered vital support.

other.title: This is not help, it's our duty…!
other.description: On Sunday, April 13, 2025, saris offered by devotees were gifted to tribal women in the village of Jirad, Alibag.

other.title: Help for Victims of the Tivre Dam Disaster
other.description: In July 2019, the Mandal extended help worth ₹5,00,000 to the families affected by the Tivre Dam disaster in Chiplun Taluka by directly visiting them with essential goods.

other.title: Jambhulpada Relief Effort
other.description: Between 1981-90, the tribal village of Jambhulpada near Panvel was devastated by floods. The Mandal rushed to provide door-to-door aid and helped stabilize the lives of the villagers.

other.title: Educational Aid in Mahad - Chiplun
other.description: On July 26, 2007, massive floods devastated Mahad and Chiplun. The Mandal distributed books, uniforms, and school supplies to help rehabilitate affected students.

other.title: K.E.M. Hospital Stretcher and Wheelchair Donation
other.description: Recognizing the increasing patient load at K.E.M. Hospital, the Mandal donated stretchers and wheelchairs, and aims to continue such contributions annually.

other.title: Blood Donation Camp
other.description: Following the principle ‘Blood donation is the greatest donation’, the Mandal has been organizing blood donation camps for 15 years, with support from KEM, Nair, and JJ hospitals.

other.title: Health Camps
other.description: Part of the festival funds go towards organizing health camps offering general check-ups, diabetes, ECG, eye & dental care, asthma, pediatric care, and cancer screenings in collaboration with top Mumbai hospitals.

other.title: Eye Check-up & Spectacles Distribution Camp
other.description: After health camps, special eye camps are held under the guidance of Padma Shri Dr. Tatyarao Lahane. Serious cases are treated at JJ Hospital, while others receive free spectacles.

other.title: Free Cataract Surgeries
other.description: Every year, the Mandal organizes free cataract surgeries for diagnosed patients through JJ Hospital under the supervision of Dr. Tatyarao Lahane. People from across India can participate.
